descriptor.name: H3 Q8 vision encoder · Preconverted (Recommended)
descriptor.description: Download ready-to-use Q8 language pages and the retained vision tower. Supports H3 text, first/last-frame and reference clips. No local conversion. Transformer, VAEs and tokenizer/processor are separate components.
